stories.title: Karnataka High Court strikes down law to increase reservation for SCs/STs, declares it unconstitutional

en.title: Karnataka High Court strikes down law to increase reservation for SCs/STs, declares it unconstitutional
en.summary: Karnataka's High Court invalidated legislation that would have increased reservations for scheduled castes and tribes, ruling that the 50% constitutional ceiling on total reservations is binding.

stories.title: Anti-CEC protests LIVE: Police seek extension of CAPF deployment in Delhi till Oct. 20 amid protest concerns

en.title: Anti-CEC protests LIVE: Police seek extension of CAPF deployment in Delhi till Oct. 20 amid protest concerns
en.summary: Delhi police have requested an extension of paramilitary deployment through October 20 in connection with ongoing protests against the CEC. The Supreme Court is hearing cases related to metro station closures during these demonstrations.

stories.title: Delhi Police seeks extension of CAPF deployment till Oct 20 amid protest fears

en.title: Delhi Police seeks extension of CAPF deployment till Oct 20 amid protest fears
en.summary: Delhi Police have requested an extension of Central Armed Police Forces deployment through October 20 due to concerns related to anticipated protests.

stories.title: Akriti Agarwal, Prithvi Shaw reconcile after calling off engagement: ‘I was misguided’

en.title: Akriti Agarwal, Prithvi Shaw reconcile after calling off engagement: 'I was misguided'
en.summary: Akriti Agarwal and Prithvi Shaw have reconciled following their earlier broken engagement, with one party indicating they had been mistaken in their previous decision.

stories.title: New Zealand-based stepsons shoot UP trader dead over mother’s 2nd marriage; CCTV emerges

en.title: New Zealand-based stepsons shoot UP trader dead over mother's 2nd marriage; CCTV emerges
en.summary: A 30-year-old trader was shot dead in his Uttar Pradesh shop by two masked assailants, allegedly his stepsons based in New Zealand. Police suspect the killing was motivated by disputes over their mother's remarriage.

stories.title: 'Delhi Doesn't Need Dark Superhero And Robin': BJP On Rahul Gandhi's Batman Mask At Protest

en.title: 'Delhi Doesn't Need Dark Superhero And Robin': BJP On Rahul Gandhi's Batman Mask At Protest
en.summary: The BJP criticized Rahul Gandhi's use of a Batman mask during a protest, stating that Delhi does not require such imagery. Gandhi wore the mask while participating in a demonstration.

stories.title: ‘Protest not offence because it displeases authorities’: Calcutta High Court quashes FIR

en.title: 'Protest not offence because it displeases authorities': Calcutta High Court quashes FIR
en.summary: The Calcutta High Court dismissed a First Information Report, ruling that protest activities do not constitute an offense simply because they displease government authorities.

stories.title: Anti-EC Protest News Live Updates: Rahul Gandhi invites INDIA bloc MPs for high tea after ‘March for Democracy’

en.title: Anti-EC Protest News Live Updates: Rahul Gandhi invites INDIA bloc MPs for high tea after 'March for Democracy'
en.summary: Rahul Gandhi invited members of the INDIA bloc of opposition parties for high tea following a democratic march protest against the Election Commission.

stories.title: ‘Dead in front of my eyes’: Mother recalls man’s fatal assault over Delhi Metro seat

en.title: 'Dead in front of my eyes': Mother recalls man's fatal assault over Delhi Metro seat
en.summary: A mother recounted witnessing a fatal assault that occurred over a dispute regarding a Delhi Metro seat, resulting in a man's death.

stories.title: "Unconstitutional": Karnataka High Court Quashes ST/SC Quota Exceeding 50% Cap

en.title: Unconstitutional: Karnataka High Court Quashes ST/SC Quota Exceeding 50% Cap
en.summary: The Karnataka High Court invalidated a quota policy for Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Castes that exceeded the constitutional 50% limit, finding it violated constitutional provisions on equality and non-discrimination.

stories.title: As Jantar Mantar loses protest site tag, CJP plans get disrupted

en.title: As Jantar Mantar loses protest site tag, CJP plans get disrupted
en.summary: Delhi Police removed Jantar Mantar from its list of designated protest sites, disrupting plans by a political party to organize a demonstration and prompting increased security measures across the city.

stories.title: Govt. move to de-notify Jantar Mantar follows SC suggestion that protest sites need more space, open air

en.title: Govt. move to de-notify Jantar Mantar follows SC suggestion that protest sites need more space, open air
en.summary: The government de-notified Jantar Mantar as a protest site following a Supreme Court suggestion to identify a larger, more open alternative location in Delhi for demonstrations.

stories.title: Oil Price Today (October 13): Crude oil falls to $105 as traders assess Russian supply, Mideast attacks. What’s next?

en.title: Oil Price Today (October 13): Crude oil falls to $105 as traders assess Russian supply, Mideast attacks. What's next?
en.summary: Brent crude declined to $105 per barrel and US crude fell to $93 per barrel as traders evaluated geopolitical tensions and Russian supply factors affecting global energy markets.

stories.title: Global Market Today: Asian shares slide as chip stocks tumble; investors eye US earnings, CPI

en.title: Global Market Today: Asian shares slide as chip stocks tumble; investors eye US earnings, CPI
en.summary: Asian stock markets declined with South Korean equities falling over 3%, following a 2.7% drop in US chipmaker stocks and a 0.7% decline in the Nasdaq 100 Index. Investors are monitoring upcoming US earnings reports and consumer price data.

stories.title: Investors shrug off bear party, put big money into equity mutual funds

en.title: Investors shrug off bear party, put big money into equity mutual funds
en.summary: Equity mutual fund inflows reached a five-month peak in September at ₹38,306.55 crore, with small-cap and mid-cap funds attracting substantial investor interest. Debt funds saw significant outflows while gold ETFs experienced increased inflows.

stories.title: IHC, First Abu Dhabi eye stake in Bandhan Bank promoter

en.title: IHC, First Abu Dhabi eye stake in Bandhan Bank promoter
en.summary: International investors GIC and IFC are seeking to exit their combined 30% stake in Bandhan Financial Services, with IHC and First Abu Dhabi among potential buyers for a 25-32% stake being marketed through adviser Jefferies.

stories.title: Top 10 blue-chips’ share of India’s m-cap drops to lowest since 2017

en.title: Top 10 blue-chips' share of India's m-cap drops to lowest since 2017
en.summary: India's top 10 blue-chip companies have seen their market capitalisation share fall to 17.65% by October 9, the lowest level since 2017, due to foreign investor selling and large-cap underperformance, while smaller companies are outperforming.
